text:
elaine: Thanks everyone for the all-hands discussion. Posting the RCA + condensed follow-up thread so owners can take items and we can close loops. Dropping links and a short action list here.

elaine: RCA: https://internal.redwood.ai/rca/INC-2026-999 (short TL;DR: autoscaler backpressure heuristic drifted under a high-burst pattern, then fallback routed to a heavier model variant causing downstream contention). Full timeline + logs in doc.

peter: reading. is the heavier model fallback disabled now?

nick: we toggled the fallback to a safe variant last night; current mitigation is a temporary rate cap + linear backoff. Need a code fix for the autoscaler heuristic.

ops-bot: deploy-event: fallback-toggle -> success; rate-cap-applied -> success. (automated)

sarah: i'll own the autoscaler heuristic fix (small refactor + unit tests). ETA: 3 business days. assigning to myself.

omar: i'll add an integration smoke that reproduces the burst pattern in CI so we don't regress. ETA: EOW.

izzy: comms: team needs a short status blurb for status.redwood.ai. Is there a preferred wording?

elaine: Suggested blurb: "Mitigation applied; autoscaler fix and CI guard in progress; service performance under observation." Keep it conservative until full validation.

ton y: (typing) can take the post-deploy perf checks (tail latency, error-rate, cpu/gpu queue depth). will pair with observability.

frances: tiny ask: can we add a release-checklist item to verify fallback model variants before deployments? Feels related.

sarah: good call, please put it in devex checklist.

ops-bot: alert-snapshot: post-mitigation error-rate -> 0.12% (5m avg). No action required yet.

elaine: ACTIONS (mirrored to tracker board):
- sarah: autoscaler heuristic code fix + unit tests (owner: sarah; due: 2026-04-10)
- omar: CI smoke reproducer for burst pattern (owner: omar; due: 2026-04-07)
- tony: post-deploy perf verification (tail latency, error-rate, queue depths) (owner: tony; due: 2026-04-06)
- frances: add fallback-variant verification to release checklist (owner: frances; due: 2026-04-05)
- izzy: draft status page blurb and stage for publication after signoff (owner: izzy; due: 2026-04-06)

elaine: please react to this thread when you've started your item so I can mark progress on the tracker. call out blockers here.

sarah: accepted: autoscaler fix -> sarah (started).

omar: accepted: CI smoke -> omar (started, note: need a small infra token for stress harness).

tony: accepted: perf verification -> tony (will run after sarah's PR lands).

frances: accepted: release checklist update -> frances (will coordinate with devex).

izzy: drafting blurb now; will paste to tracker for review.

peter: small question: should the CI smoke live in the infra repo or in the model-tests repo?

omar: putting it in infra CI makes the most sense so it runs on every cluster change. will add a short example run command to the PR.

elaine: one more thing 1: add telemetry counters for fallback-routes so we can alert if fallback rate > 0.5% for 10m. @peter can you add an alert rule?

peter: yes I'll add an alert.

elaine: thanks all. we'll reconvene next ops sync and close items on the tracker. :white_check_mark:
